summary: Grifols, S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, US equivalent of a Form 8-K) disclosing that its Board of Directors, at a 30 October 2026 meeting, approved an interim dividend against 2026 profit of €0.15 per share, payable 4 December 2026 with BBVA as paying agent. No board recommendation beyond approval, no advisor, no stake, premium or regulatory clock; this is an ordinary shareholder-return distribution rather than a tender or structural event. Watch for ex-date mechanics and any later confirmation of total capital-return policy.
